title: Meta Tags and SEO Basics
description: Understand how meta tags improve website SEO, responsiveness, and social media sharing.

lessons.title: What are Meta Tags?
lessons.content: Meta tags provide metadata about the HTML document, such as descriptions, keywords, author information, and instructions for browsers and search engines.

lessons.title: The <meta> Charset Tag
lessons.content:
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<!-- Specifies the character encoding for the document -->

lessons.title: Viewport Meta Tag for Responsiveness
lessons.content:
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<!-- Ensures the page scales correctly on mobile devices -->

lessons.title: Description Meta Tag
lessons.content:
<meta name="description" content="Learn HTML meta tags and SEO basics.">
<!-- Helps search engines understand page content -->

lessons.title: Keywords Meta Tag
lessons.content:
<meta name="keywords" content="HTML, meta tags, SEO, web development">
<!-- Lists relevant keywords for SEO (less important today) -->

lessons.title: Author and Robots Meta Tags
lessons.content:
<meta name="author" content="Your Name">
<meta name="robots" content="index, follow">
<!-- Provides author info and instructions to search engines -->

lessons.title: Open Graph Meta Tags for Social Sharing
lessons.content:
<meta property="og:title" content="My Awesome Website">
<meta property="og:description" content="A great site about HTML and SEO">
<meta property="og:image" content="image.jpg">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://example.com">
<!-- Controls how links appear on social media -->

lessons.title: Twitter Card Meta Tags
lessons.content:
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="My Awesome Website">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="Learn HTML meta tags">
<meta name="twitter:image" content="image.jpg">
<!-- Optimizes sharing on Twitter -->

lessons.title: Best Practices for Meta Tags
lessons.content: Keep descriptions concise, use relevant keywords, avoid duplication, and update meta tags regularly for SEO effectiveness.

lessons.title: Testing and Debugging Meta Tags
lessons.content: Use tools like Google Search Console, Facebook Sharing Debugger, and Twitter Card Validator to test and troubleshoot your meta tags.
